thread:
mera: Heads-up: completed canary for streaming KV-cache prefetch + soft-evict heuristics. Low-risk and measurable wins across interactive workloads :tada:

oliver: Sweet. TL;DR numbers?

mera: E2E p50 down 7%, p95 down 13%, p99 down 15% on our conversational benchmark (avg seq ~200). Token compute cost ~6% lower on canary slice. Prefetch hitrate improved from 34% -> 68% for streaming sessions.

tess: Which metric moved most on tail?

mera: p99 token generation latency improved mainly due to fewer cold KV misses and reduced KV fetch RPCs. Also lower GPU idle time due to smoother batching.

bench-bot: Canary report: 36h, traffic=5%, env=prod-canary. KV RPC rate -42%, GPU utilization up 4%, overall token compute -5.9%. Report: https://redwood-internal/bench/reports/1901234567

oliver: Any user-visible correctness risks for streaming clients?

mera: Prefetch keys are conservative: only contiguous next-prefix keys and only for active sessions. Soft-evict prevents long-term stale entries. We keep a version tag in keys and disable prefetch for routes with streaming-hooks set to "strict". No cross-user leakage.

ops-bot: Auto-fallback guard in place: runtime/kv_prefetch/p99_delta > 12% -> rollback.

tess: Rollout plan?

mera: Ramp 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 72h with automated gates on latency, kv-rpc-rate, and hitrate. Eng-sre to monitor first 25% step.

oliver: Can Dedicated customers opt-out? Any config flags?

mera: Yes, route flags: kv_prefetch.enabled (bool), kv_prefetch_scope (enum: session|route), kv_prefetch_ttl_ms (int). Default enabled; opt-out supported.

support-bot: Please add a KB note for support: how to diagnose when a customer reports "weird streaming truncation" — include prefetch toggle and fallback instructions.

mera: Will add KB + troubleshooting steps. Also adding Runtime Overview tiles: "KV Prefetch Hitrate", "KV RPC Savings", and an alert if hitrate drops >25% vs rolling 7d.

bench-bot: Scheduling full-rollout comparison at 1901310000 for final numbers to include in release notes.

oliver: One-liner for release notes/sales?

mera: Draft: "Streaming KV prefetch + soft-evict reduces KV RPCs and improves tail latency for multi-turn streaming flows. Expect p95 improvements ~10-15% and token compute savings for reuse-heavy sessions."

tess: Any anomalies during canary?

mera: Saw a small spike in memory churn on a tiny fraction of workers due to eager prefetching in ultra-high-concurrency routes; fixed by switching to a bounded prefetch window per-worker. No customer impact.

ops-bot: Monitoring updated: added runtime/kv_prefetch/evict_rate and runtime/kv_prefetch/hitrate dashboards and an alert for memory-churn spike.

oliver: Great. Could you drop 2 slides + tiny gif for next all-hands?

mera: Yep, slides + demo in #all-hands by EOD. Thanks team!
